title: Renewal Underwriting: Excessive Use of Cardinal Roadside Assistance
content:
## Rule

At the policy renewal, a Cardinal Roadside Assistance option whose vehicle used the excessive-use threshold of covered calls or more in the last 12 months is not renewed. The rest of the Cardinal Personal Auto Policy renews normally, and the customer is told with the renewal offer. Calls restored do not count.

## Thresholds

| Option | Covered calls in the window at or above which the option is not renewed | Window |
|---|---|---|
| Cardinal Roadside Basic | 5 | 12 months |
| Cardinal Roadside Standard | 6 | 12 months |
| Cardinal Roadside Plus | 6 | 12 months |
| Cardinal Roadside Plus with Trip Interruption | 7 | 12 months |
| Cardinal Roadside Premier | 8 | 12 months |
| Cardinal Roadside Premier RV & Trailer | 8 | 12 months |

## How the calls are counted

- **Window:** the rolling 12 calendar months ending on the renewal offer date.
- **Count:** the dispatches on the option in the window, less the calls restored in the window.
- **Comparison:** a count at or above the option's threshold means the option is not renewed.

## What happens

- The option is not renewed at the policy renewal; this is done by the system, and the option's status shows as nonrenewed, ending on the policy term expiration date.
- The other coverages of the auto policy renew normally.
- The customer is told with the renewal offer.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical counts on Cardinal Roadside Standard, threshold 6)

| Dispatches in the 12 months | Calls restored in the 12 months | Calls counted | Result under this rule |
|---|---|---|---|
| 6 | 0 | 6 | At the threshold: the option is not renewed |
| 5 | 0 | 5 | Below the threshold: this rule does not withhold renewal |
| 7 | 2 | 5 | Below the threshold: this rule does not withhold renewal |
| 8 | 1 | 7 | Above the threshold: the option is not renewed |

The counts are illustrative inputs.
